This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Security Operations & Detection Engineering based in the United States. We are seeking an experienced security leader to build and oversee a high-impact Security Operations function responsible for protecting cloud infrastructure, enterprise systems, and customer-facing platforms. In this strategic yet hands-on role, you will lead Security Operations, Detection Engineering, and Incident Response, ensuring threats are identified, investigated, and contained quickly and effectively. You will define the security operations roadmap, strengthen detection capabilities, and introduce automation to improve efficiency and response quality. Working closely with Cloud Security, IAM, Product Security, and Platform Engineering, you will help establish a resilient, assume-breach security posture. You will also develop a talented team, oversee critical security technologies, and translate complex risks into actionable priorities for senior leadership. This is an opportunity to shape a scalable security program within a fast-moving, AI-driven software environment.

As Director, Security Operations & Detection Engineering, you will own the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of the organization's security monitoring and incident response capabilities. You will combine technical leadership with team development, operational oversight, and cross-functional collaboration to strengthen threat detection and protect both internal environments and customer-facing services.

  • Lead Security Operations, including security monitoring, alert triage, escalation procedures, and on-call coverage.

  • Manage external Security Operations Center (SOC) and Managed Detection and Response (MDR) partners, ensuring service quality and accountability for outcomes.

  • Own the full incident response lifecycle, including playbooks, runbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communications for high-severity incidents, and post-incident reviews.

  • Establish and report key operational metrics, including detection coverage, alert quality, mean time to detect (MTTD), and mean time to respond (MTTR).

  • Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, and Customer Success teams on incident communications and customer or regulatory notification requirements.

  • Define the detection engineering strategy and roadmap, mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and prioritizing them according to actual business and customer risks.

  • Build and maintain a detection-as-code practice with peer reviews, testing standards, and a structured detection backlog.

  • Ensure appropriate security telemetry is collected across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, identity systems, endpoints, SaaS applications, and CI/CD environments.

  • Partner with platform and infrastructure teams to identify and address monitoring and telemetry gaps.

  • Validate detection effectiveness through purple-team exercises, testing, and continuous tuning to reduce false positives and unnecessary alert noise.

  • Own the SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native logging technology stack, including its roadmap, budget, and vendor relationships.

  • Improve operational efficiency through automation and AI-assisted alert triage and investigations, maintaining human oversight where necessary.

  • Integrate threat intelligence and threat hunting into detection and incident response workflows.

  • Recruit, coach, and develop SOC analysts and detection engineers while establishing a sustainable and effective on-call culture.

  • Collaborate with Cloud Security and IAM teams to align detection coverage with infrastructure and identity security controls.

  • Translate NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 objectives into a prioritized roadmap with clear ownership and executive-level reporting.

  • Support customer trust initiatives through security briefings, questionnaires, and architecture reviews.

  • Communicate security posture, operational risks, and program progress to senior leadership.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Gender Equity Consultant based in the United States. The Gender Equity Consultant will lead a time-bound, organization-wide initiative to strengthen how gender equity is understood and integrated into healthcare programs, operations, research, and communications. This role will help shape a clear organizational approach to gender and family caregiving, addressing unequal caregiving responsibilities while promoting meaningful engagement across gender identities. Working with multidisciplinary teams and community stakeholders across different countries, the consultant will assess existing practices, identify gaps, and develop practical tools to support gender-responsive and gender-transformative approaches. The position combines strategic advisory work, qualitative research, facilitation, and measurement design to turn complex gender considerations into actionable recommendations. The consultant will also support teams in testing these approaches and establishing a realistic roadmap for sustained progress toward more equitable caregiving systems.

The consultant will guide the development and implementation of a practical organizational framework for gender equity, ensuring that recommendations are evidence-based, culturally relevant, and aligned with the organization's mission and capacity. The assignment will involve organizational consultation, tool development, cross-functional facilitation, and support for measurement and continuous learning.

  • Review existing gender-related research, organizational practices, workshop findings, program approaches, and communications to assess current strengths, gaps, risks, and opportunities.

  • Consult with internal teams, gender focal points across functions and countries, healthcare workers, caregivers, patients, and other community stakeholders to understand different perspectives and experiences.

  • Facilitate organizational discussions to establish a shared understanding of gender, caregiving responsibilities, and the organization's potential contribution to gender equity.

  • Develop a concise organizational gender position statement or strategic “North Star” defining the organization's commitments, intended impact, realistic sphere of influence, and approach to avoiding harm.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen gender integration across organizational activities and recommend a focused set of priorities.

  • Apply an intersectional perspective throughout the assignment, identifying relevant social inclusion gaps and areas that may require future attention.

  • Develop a practical gender-integration guide for program and non-program teams, covering program design, implementation, health communications, research, measurement, external communications, and internal processes.

  • Define feasible gender indicators for exploratory research and evaluation, including measures related to male caregiver engagement, women's participation in decision-making, and the distribution of caregiving responsibilities.

  • Create a “do no harm” checklist to help teams identify approaches that could increase women's caregiving burdens, exclude men, reinforce harmful gender norms, or create unintended risks.

  • Provide practical recommendations for engaging male caregivers while reducing unequal caregiving responsibilities and protecting women's agency.

  • Ensure that guidance and tools can be adapted to different cultural, geographic, and health system contexts.

  • Design and facilitate working sessions with program teams, non-program functions, and community stakeholders to support practical application of the recommendations.

  • Help participating teams define realistic gender-integration actions and support their implementation and testing across program delivery, caregiver engagement, training, research, measurement, communications, and internal processes.

  • Advise teams on identifying implementation challenges, potential unintended consequences, and opportunities for adaptation.

  • Work with research, monitoring, evaluation, and program teams to establish feasible approaches to collecting, interpreting, and incorporating gender-related data into existing learning systems.

  • Develop a straightforward method for tracking team commitments, early results, implementation challenges, and unintended effects.

  • Synthesize findings from team-level applications and pilot activities, highlighting promising approaches, areas requiring refinement, and differences across contexts.

  • Recommend practical ownership structures and accountability mechanisms to ensure continued progress beyond the consultancy.

  • Produce the key consultancy deliverables, including:

  • An organizational gender position statement or “North Star” of approximately one to two pages.

  • A gender landscape and priorities summary covering existing work, strengths, gaps, risks, country-level learning, and recommendations.

  • Version 1.0 of a practical gender-integration guide, including core principles, male caregiver engagement guidance, contextual considerations, indicators, and a “do no harm” checklist.

  • Documentation of team working sessions and corresponding gender-integration action plans.

  • A pilot and early-learning synthesis outlining tested actions, findings, implementation challenges, unintended effects, and recommendations.

  • Updated gender-related positioning and communications materials, including talking points and selected external content such as donor language, case examples, stories, or caregiving webpage copy.

  • A next-phase roadmap defining priorities, ownership, capabilities, measurement improvements, and potential areas for further investment.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate will bring extensive expertise in gender equity, public health, and international development, with a proven ability to translate research and gender analysis into practical organizational and programmatic improvements. They should be comfortable facilitating discussions across diverse teams and communities, developing actionable frameworks, and helping organizations advance gender equity in ways that are measurable, context-sensitive, and sustainable.

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience in gender equity, gender and development, public health, health systems, social and behavioral change, international development, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience conducting gender analyses and translating findings into practical organizational, operational, or programmatic guidance.

  • Strong understanding of gender-transformative and gender-responsive approaches, including “do no harm” principles.

  • Experience integrating gender considerations into health or social sector programs, preferably in maternal, newborn, child, primary, community, or family health.

  • Professional experience working in at least one of the following countries: India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, or Nepal.

  • Experience developing feasible gender indicators and integrating them into monitoring, evaluation, research, or organizational learning systems.

  • Strong facilitation skills, with experience building alignment across multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

  • Excellent qualitative research, analytical synthesis, and writing skills.

  • Ability to communicate complex gender concepts clearly and make recommendations accessible and actionable for non-specialist audiences.

  • Strong understanding of family caregiving dynamics, gender roles, and the social factors influencing the distribution of caregiving responsibilities.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with internal teams, community stakeholders, and external partners across different cultural and institutional contexts.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting organizations that collaborate with government health systems.

  • Familiarity with the WHO Gender Responsive Assessment Scale or comparable gender assessment frameworks.

  • Experience developing organizational strategies, practical implementation tools, and learning roadmaps for gender equity initiatives.

    • Benefits:

  • Remote consulting opportunity based in the United States.

  • Opportunity to contribute to a meaningful initiative focused on improving health outcomes and strengthening health systems through family caregiver education.

  • Strategic influence on organizational priorities, gender integration, and approaches to equitable family caregiving.

  • Collaboration with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams across multiple countries.

  • Opportunity to develop practical tools and frameworks that can inform healthcare programs, research, measurement, and communications.

  • Engagement in a mission-driven initiative focused on reducing unequal caregiving burdens and promoting more inclusive health systems.

  • Consultant engagement: Compensation, contract duration, and specific consulting terms are not disclosed in the job description.

  • Own and oversee the end-to-end customer delivery portfolio, including new customer onboarding, existing customer change requests, new card products, tokenisation, migrations, offboarding, and data migration projects.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Support based in Israel. As Head of Customer Support, you will lead the transformation and scaling of a multi-brand customer and merchant support organisation within a fast-growing digital marketplace environment. You will bring buyer support, merchant operations, and customer experience teams together under one unified operating model, ensuring consistent service quality and operational efficiency. You will oversee managers and specialised teams while driving the adoption of AI, automation, and innovative customer support technologies. Your mission will be to improve customer satisfaction, optimise operational costs, and create seamless support experiences across multiple brands and markets. Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional departments, you will turn customer insights into meaningful product improvements and scalable solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of customer experience in a dynamic, international, and technology-driven business.
  • Design, implement, and own a unified customer support operating model across multiple products and brands, defining organisational structures, workflows, routing processes, escalation paths, and decision-making responsibilities.
  • Lead Customer and Merchant Operations, overseeing buyer support across three brands as well as merchant and wholesale support functions.
  • Manage and develop the Customer Experience organisation, including CX Managers, Subject Matter Experts, Training, RCO, automation and chatbot teams, knowledge management, and Quality Assurance.
  • Drive an automation-first customer experience strategy, increasing automated resolution rates and reducing human-agent handoffs while maintaining or improving customer satisfaction and service quality.
  • Lead the development and implementation of AI-powered customer support solutions, including AI assistants and agentic customer service workflows.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators, ensuring strong Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Internal Quality Scores (IQS), and Trustpilot performance across buyer and merchant support.
  • Optimise operational efficiency and reduce cost per contact, tracking performance against agreed targets and providing regular reporting to Finance.
  • Analyse customer contact drivers and support data to identify recurring issues, presenting actionable insights to Product teams and driving the elimination of at least two underlying customer pain points per quarter.
  • Collaborate closely with Risk, Payment Operations, Commerce, Product, and Workforce Management teams to improve operational processes and the overall customer journey.
  • Manage external service providers and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partners, ensuring compliance with service-level agreements, operational standards, and internal quality requirements.
  • Develop and mentor Operations Managers and team leads, strengthening leadership capabilities, improving team performance, and establishing a sustainable succession plan.
  • Continuously evaluate support processes, technologies, and organisational structures to ensure the function can scale efficiently as business needs evolve.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Customer Support, Customer Experience, or Customer Operations teams, with a proven track record of building and scaling support functions.
  • Previous experience managing customer support operations within a large-scale digital marketplace or e-commerce environment.
  • Demonstrated success implementing AI-powered customer service solutions and automation initiatives, with measurable results in areas such as automated resolution rates, contact deflection, automation coverage, and cost per contact.
  • Proven ability to manage multi-brand or multi-market customer support operations through a unified organisational and operational framework.
  • Experience managing external service providers and BPO partners against defined service-level agreements, with responsibility for establishing and maintaining internal quality standards.
  • Strong analytical capabilities and experience using customer contact data, operational metrics, and customer feedback to identify recurring issues and influence product development.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing managers, developing team leads, and building high-performing, scalable customer support organisations.
  • Excellent understanding of customer experience metrics, including CSAT, quality assurance, service efficiency, and operational cost management.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Risk, Finance, Commerce, and Operations teams.
  • Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach to problem-solving, process improvement, and operational execution.
  • Excellent professional English communication skills, as English is the primary working language in the international team.
  • Experience managing two-sided customer support operations, particularly buyer and seller or merchant support, is a strong advantage.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Finance based in the United States. As Head of Finance, you will provide strategic and operational leadership across financial planning, corporate finance, treasury, and business transformation. You will work closely with executive leadership, investors, and external partners to shape financial strategy and support sustainable business growth. Lead the organization's financial strategy and oversee planning, forecasting, corporate finance, treasury, and strategic initiatives.   • Partner with executive leadership to assess business performance, evaluate growth opportunities, and guide strategic investments.

  • Develop KPI frameworks, financial dashboards, and management reporting covering revenue, profitability, cash flow, and operational performance.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Procurement based in Ireland. The Head of Procurement will lead and develop the procurement function within a fast-growing, globally distributed technology organisation. Reporting directly to the CFO, you will own the end-to-end procurement strategy, operating model, systems, and commercial performance of key supplier relationships. You will combine strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in major negotiations, particularly across software, SaaS, cloud, AI tools, and professional services. Working closely with Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and business leaders, you will ensure purchasing decisions are efficient, cost-effective, and compliant. You will also drive automation and AI adoption to simplify procurement processes and improve operational scalability. This is an opportunity to build an AI-first procurement function while delivering measurable savings and supporting the organisation’s continued growth.

As Head of Procurement, you will establish the strategy, processes, and governance needed to manage company-wide purchasing effectively. You will lead strategic sourcing initiatives, optimise supplier relationships, and ensure procurement operations remain scalable, transparent, and aligned with business priorities.

  • Own company-wide sourcing, contracting, and purchasing activities, defining the procurement operating model, policies, approval processes, exceptions, and service-level agreements from initial request through contract signature and purchase order.

  • Lead negotiations for new purchases and contract renewals, particularly across software and SaaS, cloud and AI tools, and professional services, personally managing high-value and executive-level vendor discussions.

  • Drive cost reduction and technology consolidation initiatives in partnership with IT and budget owners, establishing savings targets and tracking financial impact and return on investment.

  • Collaborate with FP&A on annual budgeting and forecasting, maintaining renewal calendars, committed spend visibility, and multi-year cost projections.

  • Coordinate proactive software renewal planning with IT and business stakeholders, ensuring clear ownership, defined timelines, and effective negotiation strategies.

  • Oversee supplier governance in collaboration with Legal, Information Security, and Accounting, covering vendor risk, contractual terms, data processing agreements, supplier records, and procure-to-pay controls.

  • Manage and continuously improve the procurement technology stack, including intake-to-purchase-order workflows, financial systems, expense management, and contract management tools.

  • Establish and oversee operating models with external procurement partners, using automation and AI to reduce manual work and accelerate procurement cycles.

  • Collaborate with internal automation teams to identify opportunities to leverage process automation technology and improve procurement efficiency.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Procurement Specialist and external procurement contractor, setting priorities, managing capacity, and planning for the function’s future growth.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and budget owners on sourcing strategies, supplier risk, and procurement decisions.

  • Report key procurement performance indicators to the CFO, including savings, cycle times, policy compliance, and spend under management.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings substantial procurement and strategic sourcing experience, preferably within a scaling B2B software or SaaS environment. You should be commercially minded, comfortable leading complex negotiations, and capable of building efficient procurement processes while balancing cost control, risk management, and stakeholder needs.

  • At least 7 years of experience in procurement or strategic sourcing, ideally within a growing B2B software or SaaS company.

  • At least 2 years of experience leading and developing people.

  • Proven track record negotiating significant software and SaaS contracts and demonstrating measurable cost savings.

  • Experience establishing procurement processes and policies from an early-stage or developing function.

  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing procure-to-pay systems and procurement technology.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to assess total cost of ownership, unit economics, budget implications, contractual terms, and supplier risks.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to challenge requests constructively and propose practical alternatives.

  • Ability to design simple, efficient purchasing processes that meet the needs of internal stakeholders.

  • Practical experience using data and AI tools, with a proactive approach to automating workflows and improving personal and team productivity.

  • Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability and willingness to use the organisation’s own process automation platform.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience managing procurement across multiple legal entities, currencies, and regions, including Europe, the United States, the United Kingdom, and APAC.

  • Familiarity with SaaS procurement platforms, software purchasing optimisation, or benchmarking partners.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will own the end-to-end procurement strategy, operating model, systems, and commercial performance of key supplier relationships. You will combine strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in major negotiations, particularly across software, SaaS, cloud, AI tools, and professional services. Working closely with Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and business leaders, you will ensure purchasing decisions are efficient, cost-effective, and compliant. You will also drive automation and AI adoption to simplify procurement processes and improve operational scalability. This is an opportunity to build an AI-first procurement function while delivering measurable savings and supporting the organisation’s continued growth.

As Head of Procurement, you will establish the strategy, processes, and governance needed to manage company-wide purchasing effectively. You will lead strategic sourcing initiatives, optimise supplier relationships, and ensure procurement operations remain scalable, transparent, and aligned with business priorities.

  • Own company-wide sourcing, contracting, and purchasing activities, defining the procurement operating model, policies, approval processes, exceptions, and service-level agreements from initial request through contract signature and purchase order.

  • Lead negotiations for new purchases and contract renewals, particularly across software and SaaS, cloud and AI tools, and professional services, personally managing high-value and executive-level vendor discussions.

  • Drive cost reduction and technology consolidation initiatives in partnership with IT and budget owners, establishing savings targets and tracking financial impact and return on investment.

  • Collaborate with FP&A on annual budgeting and forecasting, maintaining renewal calendars, committed spend visibility, and multi-year cost projections.

  • Coordinate proactive software renewal planning with IT and business stakeholders, ensuring clear ownership, defined timelines, and effective negotiation strategies.

  • Oversee supplier governance in collaboration with Legal, Information Security, and Accounting, covering vendor risk, contractual terms, data processing agreements, supplier records, and procure-to-pay controls.

  • Manage and continuously improve the procurement technology stack, including intake-to-purchase-order workflows, financial systems, expense management, and contract management tools.

  • Establish and oversee operating models with external procurement partners, using automation and AI to reduce manual work and accelerate procurement cycles.

  • Collaborate with internal automation teams to identify opportunities to leverage process automation technology and improve procurement efficiency.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Procurement Specialist and external procurement contractor, setting priorities, managing capacity, and planning for the function’s future growth.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and budget owners on sourcing strategies, supplier risk, and procurement decisions.

  • Report key procurement performance indicators to the CFO, including savings, cycle times, policy compliance, and spend under management.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings substantial procurement and strategic sourcing experience, preferably within a scaling B2B software or SaaS environment. You should be commercially minded, comfortable leading complex negotiations, and capable of building efficient procurement processes while balancing cost control, risk management, and stakeholder needs.

  • At least 7 years of experience in procurement or strategic sourcing, ideally within a growing B2B software or SaaS company.

  • At least 2 years of experience leading and developing people.

  • Proven track record negotiating significant software and SaaS contracts and demonstrating measurable cost savings.

  • Experience establishing procurement processes and policies from an early-stage or developing function.

  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing procure-to-pay systems and procurement technology.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to assess total cost of ownership, unit economics, budget implications, contractual terms, and supplier risks.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to challenge requests constructively and propose practical alternatives.

  • Ability to design simple, efficient purchasing processes that meet the needs of internal stakeholders.

  • Practical experience using data and AI tools, with a proactive approach to automating workflows and improving personal and team productivity.

  • Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability and willingness to use the organisation’s own process automation platform.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience managing procurement across multiple legal entities, currencies, and regions, including Europe, the United States, the United Kingdom, and APAC.

  • Familiarity with SaaS procurement platforms, software purchasing optimisation, or benchmarking partners.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive and transparent compensation based on location, skills, and experience. For reference, published annual total target cash ranges include:

  • United States: $160,900–$259,500

  • United Kingdom: £101,100–£166,200

  • Singapore: S$199,900–S$299,800

  • Canada: C$170,900–C$281,100

  • Location-specific compensation arrangements for employees based elsewhere, with a personalised Total Rewards Calculator provided during the recruitment process.

  • Equity opportunities through a Virtual Stock Option Plan, where applicable.

  • Fully remote working arrangements and flexible time off.

  • Home office budget and co-working space support.

  • Opportunities to connect with colleagues through annual company events, team offsites, local gatherings, and dedicated connection budgets.

  • Locally tailored healthcare benefits and access to global mental wellbeing support.

  • Flexible lifestyle spending benefits covering physical activity, family care, personal interests, meaningful experiences, and financial wellbeing. The programme is scheduled to scale to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Retirement and pension plans, often including employer contributions, as well as life and disability insurance where applicable.

  • Annual professional development allowance of up to $/€/£1,000 for courses, certifications, books, and other self-directed learning.

  • An inclusive, international working environment that values diverse backgrounds and supports professional growth.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Biostatistician based in the United States. The Principal Biostatistician will provide senior-level statistical expertise and leadership across complex clinical research projects, programs, and regulatory submissions. This role involves designing and reviewing statistical methodologies, guiding clinical trial analysis, and ensuring the scientific integrity of study results. Working closely with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device sponsors, as well as internal regulatory, programming, and project management teams, you will translate complex data into meaningful clinical insights. You will also contribute to regulatory submission strategies, mentor junior statisticians, and provide expert statistical consulting throughout the drug development process. The position combines advanced technical knowledge with client-facing responsibilities and opportunities to influence industry best practices. This is an opportunity to contribute to innovative clinical research within a collaborative, globally connected, and science-driven environment.

Lead complex biostatistical projects and regulatory submissions, providing scientific guidance and technical expertise throughout the clinical development lifecycle. Collaborate with sponsors and multidisciplinary teams to ensure robust study designs, reliable statistical analyses, and high-quality regulatory deliverables.

  • Lead complex clinical research projects, programs, and regulatory submissions, managing client meetings and coordinating with sponsors, regulatory specialists, project managers, and internal stakeholders.

  • Independently develop and prepare Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), integrated Statistical Analysis Plans (iSAPs), and their associated text and shells.

  • Review and develop Analysis Data Model (ADaM) specifications, collaborating with statistical programmers and junior statisticians to resolve technical questions and review comments.

  • Provide advanced biostatistical expertise and serve as a subject matter expert, guiding colleagues on statistical methodologies, analytical approaches, and best practices.

  • Apply comprehensive drug development knowledge when designing and conducting complex statistical analyses.

  • Review and develop statistical sections of clinical study protocols, ensuring proposed methodologies align with study objectives, endpoints, and design requirements.

  • Provide statistical consulting to sponsors, offering recommendations and technical feedback on study design, analytical strategies, and sample size calculations.

  • Prepare and independently review statistical methods and results sections for Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), working closely with medical writing teams.

  • Perform sample size and power calculations across different clinical study designs and statistical scenarios.

  • Independently develop randomization plans and investigational product kit schedules, coordinating with sponsors, randomization specialists, and drug supply management teams.

  • Support Data Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs) by preparing and presenting statistical outputs in the capacity of an unblinded statistician.

  • Contribute to project planning by estimating timelines, defining project scope, and assessing resource requirements to support effective delivery.

  • Ensure the appropriate use of internal project management tools, document management systems, and collaboration platforms, including SharePoint and related workflows.

  • Stay informed about evolving regulatory guidelines, scientific developments, and industry standards to maintain the quality and compliance of statistical deliverables.

  • Develop external presentations, technical publications, blogs, and white papers to share scientific expertise and strengthen professional visibility.

  • Identify potential project challenges and recommend practical, scientifically sound solutions aligned with organizational objectives.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Cyber Advisor based in the United States. This is a senior, customer-facing cybersecurity opportunity for an experienced professional passionate about helping organizations strengthen their security posture and reduce cyber risk. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, connecting cybersecurity strategy with the practical demands of day-to-day security operations. Drawing on deep expertise in managed detection and response (MDR), endpoint security, and Splunk SIEM, you will guide customers in adopting and optimizing advanced security capabilities. You will collaborate with technical teams, business leaders, and executives to build measurable improvement plans and deliver lasting customer value. The role combines strategic advisory, hands-on technical guidance, incident response support, and thought leadership in a remote-first environment. You will also mentor fellow advisors and help shape best practices, service improvements, and customer security outcomes.

  • Own senior technical relationships for assigned strategic and complex customer accounts, partnering with Customer Success, Sales, and Operations.

  • Act as a trusted cybersecurity advisor, translating customer objectives, threat profiles, and business risks into practical security priorities and measurable outcomes.

  • Develop customer-specific service adoption plans and cybersecurity maturity roadmaps, with clear milestones, accountable owners, and defined success measures.

  • Assess MDR service health and value, including telemetry and data-source coverage, endpoint protection, detection use cases, alert quality, investigation workflows, response outcomes, and reporting.

  • Identify underused capabilities, adoption barriers, security gaps, and operational challenges, coordinating the appropriate technical, service, product, or enablement response.

  • Lead MDR optimization workshops to improve visibility, detection coverage, alert fidelity, investigation processes, escalation paths, and incident response readiness.

  • Provide technical guidance on EDR/XDR strategy, endpoint coverage, policy design, alert tuning, containment, response workflows, and security integrations.

  • Lead Splunk SIEM and security analytics discussions covering data onboarding, source coverage, normalization, correlation searches, detection content, dashboards, retention, and operational value.

  • Evaluate how SIEM, SOAR, identity, cloud, email, network, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence capabilities work together within customers' security programs.

  • Coordinate with MDR Operations, Detection Engineering, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Product, and Customer Success to resolve issues and improve customer outcomes.

  • Lead technical strategy sessions and contribute to quarterly business reviews, executive briefings, and security program assessments for technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Support customers during significant security events by facilitating communication, escalation, technical decision-making, and post-incident improvement activities.

  • Participate in purple-team and red-team reviews and tabletop exercises, translating findings into prioritized detection, response, and service improvements.

  • Represent customer needs in product and service discussions, identifying recurring challenges and opportunities to strengthen the overall offering.

  • Mentor Cyber Advisors and other customer-facing practitioners, improving the consistency and quality of technical guidance and service adoption support.

  • Develop public-facing thought leadership, blog posts, advisory resources, service adoption playbooks, maturity models, assessment methods, reference architectures, and executive-ready materials.

  • Establish customer baselines for MDR service health, maturity, coverage, utilization, and key risks; recommend high-value data sources, detections, workflows, and integrations.

  • Turn service reporting and operational insights into prioritized customer actions, tracking progress through indicators such as telemetry coverage, endpoint coverage, detection effectiveness, response readiness, service utilization, and completion of agreed actions.

    • Requirements:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, security operations, security engineering, incident response, consulting, technical account management, or a related discipline, including experience at a senior, principal, or architect level.

  • Deep practical knowledge of MDR or MSSP environments, including the people, processes, technologies, and performance metrics needed to operate them effectively.

  • Hands-on expertise with EDR/XDR platforms, endpoint telemetry, detection and response workflows, threat hunting, and containment strategies.

  • Strong Splunk SIEM experience, including architecture, data onboarding, search and correlation, detection content, dashboards, troubleshooting, and the ability to explain operational trade-offs.

  • Broad understanding of modern security programs and the integration of endpoint, identity, cloud, email, network, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and incident response capabilities.

  • Experience leading customer onboarding, technical service adoption, service health reviews, optimization workshops, quarterly business reviews, or similar technical account management activities.

  • Experience assessing or improving cybersecurity programs using recognized frameworks or practices such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, or equivalent.

  • Ability to contribute to incident response discussions and provide calm, credible technical direction during high-severity security events.

  • Strong ability to translate technical findings and service data into business risk, improvement priorities, and clear decisions for customer stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage confidently and thoughtfully with security engineers, IT leaders, and executives.

  • Sound judgment, autonomy, and organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize competing customer needs and follow through on commitments.

  • Willingness and ability to travel periodically for customer meetings, workshops, service reviews, incident support, and executive engagements as business needs require.

  • Preferred qualifications:

  • Previous experience as a Principal Cyber Advisor, Technical Account Manager, Security Architect, Solutions Architect, Principal Consultant, or SOC/MDR operations leader.

  • Experience with Splunk Enterprise Security, Splunk SOAR, or comparable security analytics and orchestration platforms.

  • Background designing or improving detection engineering programs, detection use-case lifecycles, threat hunting practices, and security operations metrics.

  • Familiarity with cloud security, zero trust, identity security, vulnerability management, or security control validation.

  • Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, GIAC, Splunk certifications, or equivalent credentials.

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

  • Regulatory requirement: This position involves access to customer data and is subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). This requirement concerns export-control compliance rather than general employment eligibility, and status will be verified upon offer.

  • Anticipated base salary of $190,000–$210,000, plus performance bonus, stock options, and benefits. Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience, education, and skills.

  • Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance.

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO), 12 company holidays, and sick leave.

  • Eight weeks of paid parental leave.

  • Annual professional development funding to support learning, skills growth, and career development.

  • 401(k) retirement program.

  • Wellness initiatives, including contests and monthly educational programs.

  • Remote work environment, with the ability to work from a home office when not at a corporate location.

Principal Software Development Engineer in Test (AI-Driven Quality Engineering)

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer in Test (AI-Driven Quality Engineering) based in Portugal. The Principal Software Development Engineer in Test will provide technical leadership for quality engineering across Windows desktop products and software development kits (SDKs). You will shape the test automation strategy while driving a new approach to AI-powered testing and continuous quality improvement. A key part of the role involves designing and deploying AI agents capable of transforming Jira tickets into reviewed test cases and automated tests integrated into CI pipelines. You will combine deep testing expertise with AI engineering to improve coverage, accelerate execution, and reduce repetitive manual work. Working in a fast-paced, collaborative engineering environment, you will define how automation and human expertise complement one another. This is an opportunity to influence engineering standards and build scalable, intelligent quality processes.

You will lead the technical direction of the SDK testing team while developing the frameworks, automation architecture, and AI-driven workflows needed to strengthen product quality. You will remain hands-on in testing and engineering, ensuring that automation delivers reliable results and that human oversight is applied where it matters most.

  • Provide technical leadership to the SDK testing team, establishing automation architecture, engineering standards, code review practices, and mentoring.

  • Develop and improve test automation frameworks, writing clean, maintainable, and reviewable test code.

  • Expand automated regression coverage by using AI agents to convert existing manual test cases into automated tests.

  • Execute manual and automated test cases, identifying, documenting, tracking, and following up on defects.

  • Monitor quality engineering performance and improve test coverage, execution speed, reliability, and overall testing efficiency.

  • Design, build, and operate AI agents across the quality engineering lifecycle, including requirements analysis, ticket assessment, test case design, test generation, execution, and failure triage.

  • Create multi-agent workflows that can take Jira tickets through to reviewed test cases and automated tests integrated into CI pipelines.

  • Manage the prompts, tools, context, and skills powering AI agents, maintaining them under version control and applying sound engineering practices.

  • Establish appropriate review and approval processes for AI-generated work, ensuring human validation for high-risk outputs while allowing greater autonomy where reliability has been demonstrated.

  • Define evaluation frameworks and performance metrics for AI agents, including test case accuracy, false positives, test flakiness, and mean time to release.

  • Build secure agent tooling by protecting sensitive credentials and restricting access to data according to security requirements.

  • Determine when exploratory or manual testing is more appropriate than automation, balancing efficiency with product reliability.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines extensive software testing and automation experience with proven technical leadership and practical experience integrating AI agents into real quality engineering workflows. You should be comfortable working across desktop applications, CI/CD environments, and complex testing infrastructure, with the judgment to balance automation, security, and human oversight.

  • At least 6 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience, including technical leadership of a team or significant initiative.

  • At least 4 years of hands-on test automation experience, including developing automated tests and supporting frameworks for desktop applications, preferably using C#.

  • At least 1 year of experience integrating AI agents into an operational quality engineering team's workflows, beyond individual use of AI coding assistants.

  • Demonstrated experience testing Windows desktop applications.

  • Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.

  • Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable tools such as TFS, TeamCity, Jenkins, or GitLab, including building pipelines, deployment jobs, and agents.

  • Strong practical testing skills, including exploratory testing and the ability to identify situations where manual validation is more effective than automation.

  • Sound judgment when evaluating AI-generated results, including determining which outputs require human review and communicating these decisions clearly to engineers and leadership.

  • Strong initiative, accountability, and adaptability, with the ability to take ownership of outcomes and contribute across multiple responsibilities.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience in the cybersecurity or information security domain.

  • Networking knowledge, including REST API testing, TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and Active Directory.

  • Experience working with Linux or Unix environments.

  • Enterprise IT administration experience, including remote software deployment, multi-user sessions, server support, backup management, security policies, and networking fundamentals.

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful work in the cybersecurity industry and make a positive impact.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages professional development, growth, and enjoyment at work.

Product Manager — Retention & Customer Value (B2B SaaS)

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager — Retention & Customer Value (B2B SaaS) based in Netherlands. As Product Manager — Retention & Customer Value, you will play a strategic role in improving customer retention, maximising customer lifetime value, and protecting recurring revenue within a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment. Operating at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, and Sales, you will take ownership of key business metrics, including churn, Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and time-to-value. You will build customer health scoring frameworks, standardise account management processes, and establish clear models for measuring customer profitability and return on investment. Working closely with cross-functional teams and senior customer stakeholders, you will translate customer insights and business data into actionable product and commercial decisions. This is a highly hands-on leadership opportunity where your work will directly influence revenue, operational efficiency, and long-term business growth. You will also have the opportunity to shape a newly established function with significant strategic influence and potential progression towards COO- or CRO-level responsibilities.
  • Develop and implement a comprehensive customer retention strategy, taking ownership of churn, GRR, NRR, customer value, and time-to-value as key business performance indicators.
  • Build a standardised customer health scoring framework based on measurable product usage, customer activities, engagement patterns, and behavioural indicators rather than individual account manager assessments.
  • Establish processes for identifying, monitoring, and managing at-risk customers, ensuring early intervention and consistent customer success practices across teams.
  • Develop revenue-risk forecasting models that quantify potential churn exposure, identify customers who can be retained, and estimate the financial impact of different retention initiatives.
  • Implement customer ROI measurement frameworks to demonstrate the value delivered to customers and establish a consistent foundation for Executive Business Reviews (EBRs).
  • Standardise EBR processes, defining meeting structures, key discussion topics, stakeholder involvement, performance presentations, and agreed action plans, including engagement with C-level customer executives.
  • Improve customer time-to-value by optimising onboarding, implementation, and adoption processes to accelerate the realisation of measurable business benefits.
  • Develop and implement customer-level economic models, tracking implementation expenses and ongoing cost-to-serve to understand the profitability and long-term value of individual accounts.
  • Use customer economics and unit economics to guide commercial decisions, including investment limits, resource allocation, and account management priorities.
  • Collect, analyse, and prioritise product requests, customer feedback, and functionality gaps that contribute to churn risk or negatively affect customer value.
  • Establish transparent decision-making processes for customer-driven product requests, ensuring that accepted and rejected initiatives are documented and their potential business impact is understood.
  • Work closely with Product teams to prioritise and deliver commercially justified product improvements that directly address retention risks and customer needs.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Sales to ensure that customer insights, retention strategies, and product priorities are aligned with commercial objectives.
  • Remain actively involved in customer interactions by participating in calls, reviewing EBRs, analysing account data, and identifying opportunities for process improvements.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of implemented initiatives, ensuring that retention improvements and customer value strategies generate measurable financial and operational outcomes.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in B2B SaaS environments, working across multiple business functions such as Product Management, Customer Success, Revenue Operations (RevOps), or Business Operations. B2C-only experience is not sufficient.
  • Strong practical understanding of recurring revenue models and SaaS business economics, including Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), churn, Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), customer acquisition and servicing costs, and unit economics.
  • Ability to independently build financial and analytical models to evaluate customer profitability, retention opportunities, revenue exposure, and customer lifetime value.
  • Proven track record of making business-critical decisions that directly influenced revenue, customer retention, or operational performance, supported by measurable results.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and improving processes across multiple teams, particularly in situations where ownership was unclear or cross-functional alignment was challenging.
  • Strong understanding of Customer Success operations and product development processes, with the ability to align customer needs, product priorities, and commercial objectives.
  • Experience translating complex customer and business data into actionable insights, structured recommendations, and measurable initiatives.
  • Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, with a strong focus on commercial outcomes and business impact.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including confidence engaging directly with senior customer stakeholders and C-level executives.
  • Hands-on and proactive working style, with a willingness to participate in customer calls, investigate operational challenges, and work directly with data.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Customer Success and drive adoption of new processes and operating models.
  • Strong organisational skills, structured communication, and a high level of ownership and accountability.
  • English proficiency at B2 level or above, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment.
  • Previous Product Management experience is considered an advantage.
  • Experience in iPaaS, payment infrastructure, fintech, or service-based businesses where customer cost-to-serve and unit economics are important is a plus.
  • Previous experience establishing customer health scoring systems, EBR programmes, or Quarterly Business Review (QBR) frameworks is highly desirable.

    • Benefits:

  • Trust & Ownership: A culture of autonomy and accountability, with no micromanagement and strong encouragement of independent decision-making.
  • Strategic Influence: Direct involvement in business-critical decisions, with a measurable impact on revenue, customer retention, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Professional Development: Financial support and reimbursement for professional courses, lectures, training programmes, and other learning opportunities.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Flexible scheduling focused on results and performance rather than fixed desk hours.
  • Annual Leave: 26 days of paid time off per year.
  • Health Insurance: Access to medical insurance to support your health and well-being.
  • Sick Leave: Unlimited sick leave without the requirement to provide a medical certificate.
  • Supportive Work Environment: An open, transparent, and collaborative culture where employees are encouraged to share ideas and challenge existing practices.
  • Social Responsibility: Opportunity to contribute to meaningful initiatives supporting Ukraine, including assistance to the Armed Forces and projects benefiting local communities.
  • Pet-Friendly Workplace: Access to a pet-friendly office environment in Kyiv, where applicable.
  • Remote Flexibility: Remote working opportunity with flexible working arrangements.
  • Employment Type: Full-time.
  • Work Arrangement: Remote.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Security Engineer based in Brazil. Join a globally distributed engineering team building developer-focused products and infrastructure designed to scale. As a Product Security Engineer, you will help embed security into the entire product development lifecycle, strengthening applications, platforms, and engineering practices. You will work closely with software engineers, infrastructure specialists, and technical leadership to identify risks early and develop practical solutions that support secure-by-default development. Your work will combine threat modeling, vulnerability management, security reviews, and automation to improve the overall security posture without slowing down innovation. This fully remote role offers the opportunity to influence security strategy in an asynchronous, fast-paced environment while helping developers build and ship confidently.

You will take ownership of key product security initiatives, partnering with engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, improve secure development practices, and establish scalable security mechanisms across products and infrastructure.

  • Identify and address gaps in application security, secure design practices, and vulnerability management.

  • Conduct threat modeling, secure design assessments, and code reviews to identify potential risks and recommend practical remediation strategies.

  • Partner with software engineering and infrastructure teams to provide product-focused security expertise and integrate security considerations into development workflows.

  • Help shape and continuously improve a modern product security program suited to a developer-first environment.

  • Assess security risks pragmatically, distinguishing theoretical vulnerabilities from material business risks to prioritize efforts effectively.

  • Strengthen security through scalable solutions, including automation, security tooling, secure defaults, and developer-friendly guardrails.

  • Support security incident response by triaging, investigating, and coordinating remediation for product and platform security issues.

  • Participate in security on-call rotations, responding to urgent events with sound judgment, clear communication, and a calm, structured approach.

  • Help manage and improve bug bounty and vulnerability disclosure programs, including vulnerability triage, validation, prioritization, and coordination with engineering teams.

  • Promote security awareness and encourage practices that enable developers to build secure products without unnecessary friction.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has a strong background in product or application security, understands modern cloud-based platforms, and can balance technical rigor with practical business judgment. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating asynchronously, and collaborating with engineering teams in a fast-moving environment.

  • Strong professional experience in product security, application security, or security engineering.

  • Experience securing cloud-native products, developer tools, SaaS platforms, or infrastructure services.

  • Deep understanding of application security fundamentals, including authentication, session management, API security, and secrets handling.

  • Experience conducting threat modeling, secure design reviews, code reviews, and vulnerability assessments.

  • Familiarity with vulnerability triage, bug bounty programs, responsible disclosure processes, or security incident response.

  • Ability and willingness to participate in a security on-call rotation and manage urgent security situations effectively.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain security risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort working in asynchronous, globally distributed teams.

  • Practical problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity while maintaining a strong focus on results.

  • Sound technical judgment and the ability to prioritize security initiatives according to their real-world impact.

  • Interest or experience in PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, or building security guardrails that empower developers rather than restrict their workflows.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Business Analyst (Data & Process Transformation) based in Australia. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Freelance) based in Switzerland. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will take ownership of bringing machine learning models out of experimentation and into production, where they directly influence real user experiences and business outcomes. Your first major initiative will focus on personalising offers and discounting decisions throughout the customer journey, particularly at key conversion moments. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Lifecycle Marketing to turn business challenges into scalable machine learning solutions. Beyond model development, you will help establish the organisation’s first low-latency ML infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on opportunity to shape production ML practices, drive measurable commercial impact, and build the foundations for future data science initiatives.

You will own the complete lifecycle of machine learning solutions, from identifying business opportunities and developing models to deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving them in production. Your work will be closely connected to product development, with success measured by the impact of models on real users and business performance.

  • Production Machine Learning Development

  • Build, validate, and deploy machine learning models for propensity prediction, pricing and discount optimisation, personalisation, churn, and lifetime value (LTV).

  • Manage the full model lifecycle, including problem definition, feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

  • Develop production-ready, tested, version-controlled, and reviewed code in close collaboration with Engineering.

  • Personalisation and Pricing Optimisation

  • Design and launch personalised discounting models that determine which offers should be presented to individual users at key moments, including paywall decisions.

  • Collaborate with Product teams to design A/B tests, holdout groups, and other experiments that demonstrate the causal impact of machine learning models.

  • Establish measurement frameworks that make pricing and discounting decisions transparent and defensible to Finance and business leadership.

  • ML Infrastructure and MLOps

  • Establish the first low-latency model-serving architecture on GCP, using technologies such as Vertex AI endpoints, Cloud Run, or equivalent solutions.

  • Define feature pipeline strategies, determining which features should be precomputed in BigQuery and dbt and which require real-time processing through Pub/Sub or similar technologies.

  • Implement model monitoring systems to track data drift, feature staleness, and prediction quality, ensuring that production models remain reliable.

  • Product and Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to translate business challenges into machine learning solutions and clear technical requirements.

  • Convert model outputs into well-defined API contracts that Engineering can integrate into product experiences.

  • Document technical processes and handoffs so that Engineering can independently maintain and manage the serving layer over time.

  • Experimentation and Causal Inference

  • Develop uplift and causal models to identify which users are most likely to respond to specific offers or interventions.

  • Design and interpret controlled experiments to measure the incremental impact of models on revenue, retention, and customer reactivation.

  • Establish a repeatable experimentation framework for evaluating and improving machine learning models.

  • Expected Outcomes

  • Launch a personalised discounting model in production that supports real-time paywall decisions for actual users.

  • Establish a documented and reusable low-latency model-serving architecture on GCP.

  • Demonstrate measurable incremental improvements in a key business metric, such as paywall conversion, discount efficiency, or lapsed-payer reactivation, through controlled experimentation.

  • Implement monitoring and alerting systems that identify model drift and performance degradation quickly.

  • Create a repeatable model-to-production framework that can be adopted by other team members.

  • Establish and maintain payment controls, including approval procedures for exceptional payments, corrections, and adjustments.

  • Develop a clear escalation framework with defined ownership, response expectations, and decision-making guidelines, empowering team members to resolve issues independently while ensuring complex matters receive appropriate attention.

  • Ensure all operational documentation and SOPs remain accurate, current, and clearly owned, while developing reusable frameworks to prevent recurring issues.

  • Define and monitor team KPIs, including remittance accuracy, case resolution performance, and service-level achievement.

  • Use operational data to identify root causes, guide coaching and resource allocation, and communicate performance trends, underlying drivers, and corrective actions to senior leadership.

  • Monitor outstanding customer credits and provide regular reporting on trends, causes, and potential operational improvements.

  • Build effective cross-training, onboarding, and coverage strategies to maintain operational continuity as the business grows.

  • Lead organizational and process changes by communicating objectives, setting expectations, and managing temporary productivity impacts associated with new tools, workflows, or structures.

  • Foster a transparent, collaborative, and blameless team culture where employees feel comfortable raising concerns early and treating mistakes as opportunities for process improvement.

  • Integrate AI-first practices into everyday team operations, identifying opportunities to reduce manual work and improve productivity.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer, Data Visualization and Platform based in India. As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you will take ownership of quality assurance for a sophisticated data exploration platform used to analyze high-frequency telemetry across mission-critical systems. You will design and expand automated testing strategies for complex data visualization features and a GPU-accelerated charting engine. Your work will help identify functional, performance, and cross-browser regressions before they reach customers. You will also transform manual performance checks into reliable, repeatable automated tests integrated into continuous integration workflows. Working closely with frontend engineers and quality specialists, you will influence testing practices, improve release confidence, and help scale quality engineering across the platform. This remote opportunity combines technical ownership, collaboration across time zones, and exposure to advanced data infrastructure technologies.

You will lead end-to-end test automation for data visualization and core application features, ensuring that new functionality, platform improvements, and chart migrations meet high standards of reliability and performance.

  • Own and maintain the end-to-end Playwright test suite covering panels, annotations, data sources, sharing, and plotting functionality.

  • Ensure automated smoke tests and critical user journeys run on every pull request, establishing reliable quality gates for code merges and releases.

  • Improve test stability, reduce flaky tests, and define clear criteria for blocking releases.

  • Expand cross-browser test coverage to include Microsoft Edge and Firefox alongside Chrome, with particular attention to Windows environments.

  • Automate frontend performance testing by converting existing browser and hardware performance studies into repeatable checks with frame-time and lag thresholds.

  • Use telemetry simulation to reproduce realistic channel counts and data rates during performance testing.

  • Introduce visual regression testing for charts and panels where it provides reliable and meaningful feedback.

  • Develop parity tests to compare legacy chart views with their new-engine equivalents across time-series, scatter, histogram, FFT, and 3D visualizations.

  • Identify testing gaps across the core application and build regression coverage for role-based and attribute-based access control (RBAC and ABAC), service accounts, folders, navigation, the home page, search, and the design system.

  • Onboard and guide a Quality Engineer working in another time zone, coordinating overnight regression activities and reviewing test results.

  • Collaborate with engineers before implementation and code merges by reviewing test plans, advocating for unit test coverage, and testing features ahead of release.

  • Monitor and report quality metrics, including test pass rates, flaky test frequency, and performance trends, while communicating regressions promptly.

    • Requirements:

    You bring substantial experience in QA automation or software development engineering in test (SDET), with a strong background in testing complex web applications. You are comfortable designing scalable automation frameworks, analyzing frontend performance, and collaborating with engineers to build quality into the development lifecycle.

  • 5+ years of experience in QA automation or SDET roles, including at least 2 years building UI test suites for complex web applications.

  • Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript, with experience designing complete test suites involving fixtures, test data setup, tagging, parallelization, and flakiness management.

  • Experience integrating end-to-end tests into continuous integration pipelines, ideally using GitHub Actions as a blocking gate for pull requests.

  • Hands-on cross-browser testing experience with Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox across Windows and macOS.

  • Practical frontend performance testing experience using browser developer tools, performance traces, frame-rate measurements, and rendering analysis.

  • Ability to read and understand React code and write unit tests using Vitest or Jest.

  • Experience testing authorization mechanisms, including RBAC and ABAC, as well as backend APIs.

  • Familiarity with Go services and gRPC is an advantage.

  • Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English (CEFR B2 or above), with the ability to participate in design reviews, prepare test plans and risk reports, and collaborate with and train teammates.

  • Availability for at least 4 hours of daily working-time overlap with US Pacific time.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take ownership of testing strategy and communicate quality risks effectively.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience testing data visualization, charting, WebGL, or applications that rely heavily on canvas rendering.

  • Familiarity with real-time or streaming data products.

  • Experience implementing visual regression testing using Playwright screenshots or similar tools.

  • Python scripting skills for test data preparation and load generation.

  • Knowledge of telemetry, time-series data, or hardware testing workflows.

  • Experience using AI agents to write and maintain automated tests.

  • Experience testing software deployed in customer-managed cloud or on-premises environments.

  • Fully remote, full-time-equivalent independent contractor engagement.

  • Monthly compensation of $4,000–$4,500 USD for candidates based in Latin America or the Caribbean.

  • Opportunity to work on advanced data infrastructure and visualization technologies.

  • Exposure to GPU-accelerated charting, real-time telemetry, and complex engineering systems.
